name: Fold-down drying rack
description: Cabinet-side-mounted fold-down clothes drying rack (aluminium rods in a frame, hinged along one edge). fold "up": stored standing up flat against the panel; fold "down": stored hanging down. standoff holds it off the panel so a lower rack can be stored in front of an upper one (open the front one first). How it is held up when out is not modelled. Typical sizes 60-80 wide, 40-100 out; generic planning model. Double-click to fold out / in (with `levels`, all racks at once).
